items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, well he had the Peerless band with John McCurtis.

ctx.x: It's your band, it's your band when the band comes, but you can't remember all the names. Yeah.
Yeah, well he had the Peerless band with John McCurtis. Who? Frank and McCurtis Peerless band. Peerless. Peerless. Peerless. Yeah, well that's been a while, man. Yeah, very cool.

How about when you go to the Grove Hall, would you see some white people there or it's only colored? I don't know. I don't see any colored out there. I see. How about Lincoln Park over here? I don't see any white people. No? No.
